items.text: Green Bay: G Sean Rhyan (ankle) out at least a month. WR Christian Watson (rib fracture) expected to play with padding; LB Zaire Franklin (hairline shin fracture) not going on IR. EDGE Micah Parsons (ACL, PUP) returned to practice, targeting Week 12. Out for season: DT Javon Hargrave, WR Jayden Reed, LB Edgerrin Cooper.

New England (TBD): WR A.J. Brown (knee/ankle), TE Hunter Henry (undisclosed, left Week 8), RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness), LB Gabe Jacas (knee). On IR: WR Romeo Doubs (after Week 11 bye), G Mike Onwenu (season), G Alijah Vera-Tucker.
